title: The dashboard got a quieter, sharper visual language
summary:
A UI-heavy day: a calmer dashboard, a rebuilt Websim, and Pollinations components that now work straight from a script tag.

The playground and model monitor now use a single-accent theme, custom icons, and borderless controls for a cleaner dark-mode interface. The models page also brought back one-click model-slug copying, while moving descriptions behind an info control so the table stays useful rather than decorative.

Websim was rebuilt with the Pollinations SDK and UI kit, adding a responsive centered layout plus dedicated Save and Open actions. It now routes through the app proxy with proper canonical metadata, and the deployment path learned how to handle Worker-backed apps and domain cutovers without getting lost in its own plumbing.

A browser-ready IIFE bundle now exposes Pollinations UI as window.PollinationsUI, so components can be loaded from a CDN in plain HTML, CodePens, and other places where installing a bundler would be an unreasonable amount of ceremony. The package's auth SDK subpath was also exported correctly, keeping React and Vite consumers building cleanly.
